lawyer:
Nurul Islam Bhuiyan, Advocate-on-Record.  ------ For the Petitioner.
For the Respondent ------ Not represented.
parties:
Md. Jasimuddin Sarker   ------ Accused-Petitioner. (on bail)
Vs.
The state, represented by the Deputy Commissioner, Mymensingh and others. ------ Respondents.
full_judgment:
Mohammad Fazlul Karim J: This criminal petition for leave to Appeal at the instance of the petitioner is directed against the judgment and order 06.03.2005 passed by the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 6097 of 2002 discharging the Rule the arising out of an application under Section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure for quashing the proceeding of Special Case no. 1 of 2001 of Kotwali P.S. Case No.19(11) of 1994 under Section 420/406/210/109 of the Penal Code read with section 5(2) of the Anti-corruption Act, II of 1947 now pending before the Special Judge, Mymensingh. 

 2. The facts of the case, in short, are that the Inspector, District Anti-Corruption Bureau of Moymensingh on 12.11.1994 lodged an First Information Report with the Kotwali Police Station alleging, inter-alia, that the accused Nirma Lendu Ghose Dhiraz Ghose and with accused Md. Badruddoza, V.P. Super and Md. Asraf Hossain, Advocate V.P. lawyer filed Other 9 class suit No. 213 of 1981 for specific performance of contract and obtained judgment and decree on 22.06.1985 and they also obtained saf-kabala deed registered through the Court vide Execution Case No. 1 of 1986 on 22.04.1991. The V.P. Super received the case record of V.P. case No. 262(ka) 66-67 on 08.07.1984 from V.P. Advocate and in convinance of each other concealed the file for misappropriation of the said property thereby committed an offence under Section 204/210/109/420 of the Penal Code read with Section 5(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947. 

 4. The special Judge framed charge under section 420/406/210/109 of the penal Code read with Section 1947 in special Case No. 1 of 2001. 

 5. Mr. Nurul Islam Bhuiyan, learned Advocate-on-record, appearing for the petitioner submitted that the High Court Division committed a grave error of law, occasioning failure of justice not finding to the effect that the petitioner has purchased   the property by saf-kabala deed from the decree-holder who obtained saf-kabala deed through Court in an execution proceeding; that the Government did not file any appeal against the said judgment and decree. Therefore, the instant proceeding is against the bonafide purchaser and it is an abuse of the process of Court that he has no connection in obtaining the decree through Court for which the instant proceeding against the petitioner is liable to be quashed; that this is a case of civil nature and criminal case will not lie in criminal Court and the learned Court below illegally framed charge under Sections 420/406/210/109 of the Penal Code read with Section 5(2) of the Anti-corruption Act, 1947 against the petitioner that there is no ingredient of sections 420/406/210/109 of the Penal Code Read with Section 5(2) of Anti-corruption Act, 1947 but the learned Court below illegally framed a charge against the petitioner under Sections 420/406/210/109 of Penal Code read with section 5(2) of the Anti-corruption Act, 1947; that there is no name of the petitioner in the First Information Report and no allegation against the petitioner and without cogent reason the petitioner's name has been included in the charge sheet.
